title: Rustic Valley
description: Rustic Valley is a cozy-tech Fabric modpack focused on peaceful progression, farming, cooking, exploration, light magic and immersive automation
body:
Rustic Valley is a cozy-tech Fabric Modpack focused on peaceful progression, farming, cooking, exploration, light magic and immersive automation

built for my own personal use i decided to make a pack that felt more about peace and calmness and actually ran on my pc unlike some heavily bloated modpacks. Rustic Valley combines the mechanical creativity of Create-style engineering with cozy farming,  beautiful terrain, relaxed exploration and atmospheric building The pack is designed around smooth performance, long term survival worlds, with a Vanilla+ feel with satisfying progression without overwhelming grind. 

whether you are building a country side railway, running a bakery with automated kitchens, exploring forests and caves or slowly industrializing a peaceful village, Rustic Valley aims to feel warm, immersive and creative instead of chaotic
